mentions.name: Mojave Studio
mentions.description: Mac image editor whose "Smart Folders" feature is an equivalent to Photoshop's Smart Objects: an embedded sub-document is shown inline with its own identity transform while the rest of the document gets the inverse transform applied, letting you examine how it sits in context, similar to inspecting shadow DOM in a web inspector.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm really pleased with how my equivalent to Smart Objects turned out in Mojave Studio, my Mac image editor.
mentions.author: jpsimons
